incidentHistory.title: Discord overlay false positive spike
incidentHistory.rootCause: Discord canary build changed overlay injection pattern. Kernel layer flagged it as DLL injection. Updated whitelist within 3 hours.
incidentHistory.impact: ~40 false flags, 0 false bans (all below auto-ban threshold)

incidentHistory.title: Behavioral model latency regression
incidentHistory.rootCause: ONNX model update (bm-3.0.9) doubled inference time to 4.8ms on older CPUs. Rolled back, re-optimized, and redeployed as bm-3.1.0.
incidentHistory.impact: No detection failures. Scan latency exceeded 4ms target on i5-10th gen and older.
